name: Twenty v2 CRM Sales Workspace
description: Modern open-source CRM with background workers and S3 storage. Own your data.

Twenty.preDeployCommand: /bin/sh -c "i=0; until psql $PG_DATABASE_URL -tAc 'select 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge 90 ]; then echo 'Postgres not reachable'; exit 1; fi; sleep 2; done; DISABLE_DB_MIGRATIONS=false DISABLE_CRON_JOBS_REGISTRATION=true exec /app/entrypoint.sh true"

PORT.description: Port Railway routes to and healthchecks (must equal NODE_PORT).

NODE_PORT.description: Port the Twenty server listens on.

SERVER_URL.description: Public URL of this instance (links, OAuth callbacks). Update it when you add a custom domain.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis for cache and BullMQ queues. family=0 lets ioredis use IPv4 or IPv6 on the private network.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Primary key for at-rest encryption of stored secrets (connected-account tokens, API keys). Never change it without a rotation (see FALLBACK_ENCRYPTION_KEY in Twenty docs).

APP_SECRET.description: Legacy application secret, kept for compatibility and as fallback key. Do not change after first boot.

STORAGE_TYPE.description: File storage driver. S_3 keeps attachments in the Railway Bucket so server and worker share them and the server stays stateless.

LOGIC_FUNCTION_TYPE.description: Logic functions / workflow code steps. LOCAL runs user code unsandboxed inside the container: enable only if every workspace member is trusted.

EMAIL_DRIVER.description: LOGGER writes e-mails to the logs. Set SMTP (and the EMAIL_SMTP_* values) to send invitations and password resets. Can also be set in Settings > Admin Panel.

EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Sender address for system e-mails, e.g. crm@yourcompany.com. Optional.

EMAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Sender display name for system e-mails.

EMAIL_SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP host, e.g. smtp.gmail.com or smtp.office365.com. Optional.

EMAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP password or app password. Optional.

AUTH_GOOGLE_ENABLED.description: Allow 'Sign in with Google' (needs the Google client below).

MESSAGING_PROVIDER_GMAIL_ENABLED.description: Enable Gmail sync (needs the Google client below).

CALENDAR_PROVIDER_GOOGLE_ENABLED.description: Enable Google Calendar sync (needs the Google client below).

AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID (Google Cloud console). Optional.

AUTH_GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL.description: Authorised redirect URI for Google sign-in. Register it in Google Cloud.

AUTH_GOOGLE_APIS_CALLBACK_URL.description: Authorised redirect URI for Gmail/Calendar sync. Register it in Google Cloud.

AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENABLED.description: Allow 'Sign in with Microsoft' (needs the Microsoft app below).

AUTH_MICROSOFT_CALLBACK_URL.description: Redirect URI for Microsoft sign-in. Register it in Entra ID.

AUTH_MICROSOFT_APIS_CALLBACK_URL.description: Redirect URI for Microsoft mail/calendar sync. Register it in Entra ID.

DISABLE_DB_MIGRATIONS.description: Migrations run in the pre-deploy command, not at container start, so replicas never migrate concurrently.

DISABLE_CRON_JOBS_REGISTRATION.description: The server registers Twenty's background cron jobs on start (idempotent).
